$description: S5 painterly spike tokens (illustrative reconstruction, spike). Every number the filter uses lives here; painterly.js has no per-image branches beyond 'mode' (flat | equirect), 'mono' and 'background.mode'. Lengths are pixels at the reference size: portraits are scaled to 1024 px tall, equirects are 4096 x 2048, and target.scale multiplies every length.

kuwahara.$description: Anisotropic Kuwahara after Kyprianidis et al. 2009 with the polynomial sector weights of Kyprianidis, Semmo, Kang and Doellner 2010. sectors is fixed at 8 in the shader.

flow.$description: Stroke direction: minor eigenvector of the smoothed colour structure tensor plus a weak prior tensor, so flat areas get strokes at priorAngleDeg (image space, 0 = to the right, positive = clockwise because y points down) varied by priorJitterDeg over priorScale px.

light.$description: Impasto light in image space, x right, y down, z toward the viewer: from the upper left.

palette.$description: Mono sources: luminance is mapped through 'monoRamp' (this assigns colour by brightness; it is a stylistic grade, not evidence of real colour). Colour sources keep their hue and are pulled toward the same ramp by 'colourMapMix'. autoLevels: luminance percentiles mapped to 0 and 1 before grading (a tonal stretch, applied equally to all channels).

background.$description: Used only where a background mask exists (portraits). 'regrade' maps the original background luminance through bgRamp; 'field' is a painted abstract field from 3D value noise; fieldMix blends them. The person (mask 0) is never touched by this stage.

mask.$description: No-ML background mask: region growing from the image border over low-gradient, slowly varying luminance, then a chamfer distance feather that lies entirely on the background side.

muir.$note: region-growing mask leaked into the face and coat (soft-focus print, coat and backdrop share one tone); background left to the palette ramp

naismith.$note: halftone plate; the mask leaked into the dark suit; background left to the palette ramp

volume.$description: pseudo-volume for flat vector art: multiply by edgeDark at the silhouette rising to 1 over edgePx, times a light from the upper left (+/- directional). Only for the fictional guide; never for photographs.

svgOutline.$description: recolour the SVG ink stroke and scale every stroke width before rasterising (the SVG file is not changed)

roomPalette.$description: overrides of 'palette' for the constructed room (flat and equirect) so the room's warm S2 colours are pulled toward the portrait ramp
